name: system.info
description: Returns OS family identifier, version, hostname, screen geometry, and a capability map. Used by clients to gate verb availability before sending family-specific calls.
x-strict-false-reason: The `capabilities` field is an open-ended per-family sub-capability map; its keys evolve per family and per agent build. A closed schema would defeat the discovery role of this verb. Per Option 13 design subsection C, strict mode is per-tool — system.info opts out while every other verb stays strict.

family.description: Agent product family. Strict enum sourced from spec/families.json keys.

agent.description: Agent software name, e.g. "AgentRemoteHands". Mirrored by `connection.hello.agent`.

agent_protocol.description: Wire-protocol version this agent speaks, e.g. "2.1". Negotiated to highest-mutual at connection.hello time. Mirrored by `connection.hello.agent_protocol`.

os_name.description: Human-readable OS product name, e.g. `"Windows 11 Pro"`, `"Windows NT 4.0 SP6a"`. Added per issue #80.

os_version.description: OS version designation, e.g. `"22H2"`, `"10.0.22621"`. Free-form per agent emitter; chosen for operator-visibility.

cpu_arch.description: CPU architecture the agent process is running as. Sourced from `IsWow64Process2` (modern) or `GetNativeSystemInfo` (classic). Per issue #78.

integrity.description: Agent process's Windows Integrity Level. `none` on OSes that lack ILs (NT 4 / 9x / 2000). Sourced from `GetTokenInformation(TokenIntegrityLevel)` at startup; cached. Per issues #5 / #23 / #79.

uiaccess.description: True when the agent binary has the UIAccess flag set (signed manifest with `<requestedExecutionLevel uiAccess="true"/>`), allowing it to drive higher-IL UI without itself being elevated. Sourced from `GetTokenInformation(TokenUIAccess)` at startup; cached. Per issue #13.

index.description: 0-based monitor index. Matches `window.list.monitor_index` (when `include_monitor: true`), `input.position.monitor_index` (when `include_monitor: true`), and `screen.capture.monitor`.

bounds.description: Monitor's screen position and size in virtual-screen coordinates.

primary.description: True for the monitor `EnumDisplayMonitors` reports first.

scale.description: DPI scaling factor (1.0=96 DPI, 1.5=144, 2.0=192). Optional; omit if the agent is DPI-unaware.

screens.description: Per-monitor geometry. Strict-authored per issue #74 under the mock-up's `screens` field name. Always at least one entry on a system with a display.

capabilities.description: Open-ended per-family sub-capability map. Common keys (per the windows-modern / windows-classic families): `ui_automation`, `wgc`, `gdi`, `uipi`, `integrity_levels`, `image_formats`, `wake_timer_supported` (issue #82), `input_settings` (issue #86).

x-implementations.name: agent_native
x-implementations.description: Composed from RtlGetVersion / GetVersionEx, GetSystemMetrics, EnumDisplayMonitors + GetMonitorInfo, GetDpiForMonitor (modern only), IsWow64Process2 / GetNativeSystemInfo (cpu_arch), GetTokenInformation(TokenIntegrityLevel + TokenUIAccess) (integrity + uiaccess), GetDoubleClickTime + SystemParametersInfo (for capabilities.input_settings), and the agent's runtime configuration.

windows-modern.description: Composed from RtlGetVersion (os_name + os_version), GetSystemMetrics, EnumDisplayMonitors + GetMonitorInfo + GetDpiForMonitor (screens), IsWow64Process2 (cpu_arch), GetTokenInformation(TokenIntegrityLevel) for `integrity` and GetTokenInformation(TokenUIAccess) for `uiaccess` (both cached at agent startup), and GetDoubleClickTime + SystemParametersInfo (capabilities.input_settings). `capabilities` typically reports `ui_automation: yes`, `wgc: yes`, `integrity_levels: full`, `uipi: yes`, `image_formats: [png, webp, bmp]`, `wake_timer_supported` (true on bare-metal and modern Hyper-V on Win 11 hosts), and `input_settings` (OS double-click / keyboard repeat / wheel-scroll values).

windows-classic.description: Composed from GetVersionEx, GetSystemMetrics, EnumDisplayMonitors + GetMonitorInfo (screens, no DPI scaling), GetNativeSystemInfo (cpu_arch — IsWow64Process2 unavailable pre-Win-10), and GetDoubleClickTime + SystemParametersInfo (input_settings; NT 4 / 9x agents may omit `wheel_scroll_lines`). `integrity` is `"medium"` on NT 5.1+ (XP, 2003 — token integrity backported in form), `"limited"`-equivalent only on Vista+; NT 4 / 2000 / 9x report `"none"`. `uiaccess` is always false on classic (no UIAccess subsystem pre-Vista). `capabilities` typically reports `ui_automation: no`, `wgc: no`, `integrity_levels: limited` (or `none` on NT 4 / 2000), `uipi: no`, `image_formats: [bmp]` plus `png` if a GDI+ runtime is detected at startup, and `wake_timer_supported` (true on XP+ bare-metal; false on NT 4 / 2000 / VM guests).
